reasoning: Recent Mississippi-specific information found in the last 45 days does not show any released statewide general-election polling for the 2026 Senate or presidential race. The strongest current context is that the available Mississippi Senate reporting and market data still points to a Republican hold by a safe margin, but because no qualifying head-to-head general-election poll was found in the retrieved sources, there is no current poll-based D/R margin to report.

sources.name: New York Times - Mississippi U.S. Senate Election 2026: Latest Polls
sources.details: Mississippi Senate polling from Impact Research showed Cindy Hyde-Smith ahead of Scott Colom by 3 points in a head-to-head matchup.
